tools.name: get_market_state
tools.description: Use when the user asks about the current market state (trend or momentum) of a crypto asset on any timeframe from 1 minute to 1 month. Returns state data only: no prices, forecasts or trade signals. Current DAMO market state of one symbol across 10 timeframes: state name and permanent code per timef

tools.name: get_market_states
tools.description: Use when the user asks about several crypto assets at once. Same as get_market_state for up to 50 symbols in one call.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: Use to check whether DAMO covers an asset and which symbol name to use. Symbols covered by DAMO, with available layers and any timeframe not yet available.

tools.name: get_state_definitions
tools.description: Use when the user asks what DAMO's states, codes or layers mean. The 4 permanent DAMO states and codes, timeframe order, the verified/live layers and what DAMO outputs (state data only).
